SMTO-SKL-0096 — SMTO couldn't reach your saved Microsoft 365 settings

GUID: 96b34ae9-0fe0-5208-bb32-84c449c4221c
Slug: microsoft365-parameter-store-required
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • Microsoft 365 needs SMTO's saved settings, called Parameter Store, to find your account. This action ran somewhere that couldn't reach them, so nothing was sent to Microsoft.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open a conversation and ask the Agent to do the Microsoft 365 action there. Normal conversations can reach your saved Microsoft account; some other places can't.
  2. If it happens in a normal conversation too, select Copy error details in this panel. The details show which part of SMTO couldn't reach your saved settings.

What success looks like

  • The Agent can list your Microsoft 365 accounts and carry out the request.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who installed SMTO; the installation may be incomplete. Don't create new Microsoft accounts or apps to work around it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • microsoft365 provider_for received no Parameter Store (no store) from the execution context, so Microsoft account and token lookup cannot run.

What this means

  • Microsoft provider construction receives no Parameter Store. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Microsoft provider construction receives no Parameter Store.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the service context that supplies the profile store.

How to fix it

  • Invoke microsoft365 tools through a normal Agent run on the Server, where the execution context supplies the Parameter Store (agent_runtime.parameters.context._parameter_store_from_context). If a normal conversation run hits this, the Server's Parameter Store wiring is broken; check the Server log and installation before retrying.
  • Run through a supported service context with Parameter Store configured; then select the intended account.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported runtime provides Parameter Store before the provider is invoked.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
